probs[decoy] = 0.0\n            actions -= 1\n            for i in range(40):\n                if i == decoy or probs[i] == 0.0: continue\n                ah = pois(rng, 0.30 if i == mole else for i in range(40):\n                        if i not in rec:\n                            probs[i] = 0.0\n                        elif is_c:\n                            n_vars = Now, on successive days, `check_leak_feed` will only trigger when this value of `V` is zero or dropping. This drastically streamlines the processing.\n\n\n**Analyzing Log Patterns**\n\nI've been analyzing the `after_hours` logs on Days 1 and 2 and I've found a crucial pattern. The decoy, `e33`, consistently shows up as the primary element in these logs. I confirmed that messages won't give any hints. On Day 2, only `e33` and `e21` were logged as `after_hours: true`! This is very important. I will focus on the documents from Day 3 to see if this pattern continues, specifically looking at documents that are sales and legal.\n\n\n**Interpreting Day-3 Anomalies**\n\nI've made a significant leap! The complete absence of regular documents for Research, Finance, and Engineering on both Day 2 and Day 3 is very telling. It suggests the only documents those departments received in the crucial 3-day leak window were canaries. All Day-1 docs expire tomorrow! This is a massive narrowing of suspects. I must now consider the implications for Day 4, given the current canary situation, and decide about Day 3 canaries.\n\n\n","time":{"start":1794697591669,"end":1794697600856}}}

d2 recent_documents\n    (\"e07\", False), # d3 contacts_outside\n    (\"e02\", False), (\"e02\", False), (\"e02\", False), # d4 3 topics\n    (\"e08\", False), (\"e08\", False), (\"e08\", False), # d4 3 topics\n]\n\ndef compute_posteriors(use_d1_noleak=True):\n    scores = {e: 1.0 for e in SURVIVORS}\n    if use_d1_noleak:\n        # Eng held docs on day 1; if mole in Eng, didn't leak on day 1 (prob 0.35 under random/default)\n        for e in ENG:\n            scores[e] *= 0.35\n    \n    for day in [1, 2, 3, 4]:\n        for e in SURVIVORS:\n            if day == 1 and e in SALES:\n                # Sales held 0 docs on Day 1 -> 0 logs for both mole and innocent\n                continue\n            ah = sum(1 for emp, is_ah in LOGS[day] if emp == e and is_ah)\n            nm = sum(1 for emp, is_ah in LOGS[day] if emp == e and not is_ah)\n            # Innocent rate: ah = 0.10 + (1.0 / (30 if day==1 else 38)), nm = 0.90\n            lam_ah_inn = 0.10 + (1.0 / (30.0 if day == 1 else 38.0))\n            lam_nm_inn = 0.90\n            lam_ah_mol = 0.30\n            lam_nm_mol = 0.70\n            lr = ((lam_ah_mol / lam_ah_inn) ** ah) * math.exp(-(lam_ah_mol - lam_ah_inn)) * \\\n                 ((lam_nm_mol / lam_nm_inn) ** nm) * math.exp(-(lam_nm_mol - lam_nm_inn))\n            scores[e] *= lr\n\n    for emp, ev in INTERVIEWS:\n        scores[emp] *= (0.24 / 0.20) if ev else (0.76 / 0.80)\n\n    tot = sum(scores.values())\n    return {e: scores[e] / tot for e in SURVIVORS}\n\np_with = compute_posteriors(True)\np_without = compute_posteriors(False)\nfor e in sorted(SURVIVORS, key=lambda x: -p_with[x]):\n    dept = \"Sal\" if e in SALES else \"Eng\"\n    ah_cnt = sum(1 for d in LOGS.values() for emp, is_ah in d if emp == e and is_ah)\n    nm_cnt = sum(1 for d in LOGS.values() for emp, is_ah in d if emp == e and not is_ah)\n    print(f\"{e} ({dept}): P(with_d1)={p_with[e]:.4f}, P(no_d1)={p_without[e]:.4f} | ah={ah_cnt}, nm={nm_cnt}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/tracker.py","time":{"start":1794697735264,"end":1794697735276}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dc522c4d0018VIvZKJk0QQz20","sessionID":"ses_e23bcbea6ffeVrehhsvacM3RC1","messageID":"msg_1dc51c890001qT5JivniLK55xM"}}

lam_ah_inn)) * \\\n             ((lam_nm_mol / lam_nm_inn) ** nm) * math.exp(-(lam_nm_mol - lam_nm_inn))\n        scores[e] *= lr\n\nfor emp, ev in INTERVIEWS:\n    scores[emp] *= (0.24 / 0.20) if ev else (0.76 / 0.80)\n\ntot = sum(scores.values())\nfor e in sorted(ENG, key=lambda x: -scores[x]):\n    tot_ah = sum(DAY_LOGS[d][e][0] for d in range(1, 7))\n    tot_nm = sum(DAY_LOGS[d][e][1] for d in range(1, 7))\n    print(f\"{e}: P = {scores[e]/tot:.4f} | total ah={tot_ah}, nm={tot_nm}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/eng_post.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/eng_post.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/eng_post.py","time":{"start":1794697909616,"end":1794697909628}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dc54d51e001WuGE3ycYVaMBxC","sessionID":"ses_e23bcbea6ffeVrehhsvacM3RC1","messageID":"msg_1dc547bd3001xAy7JVI1L7RlJ5"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794698344278,"sessionID":"ses_e23bcbea6ffeVrehhsvacM3RC1","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"x50fi33TBndHqZlj","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/eng_post.py","content":"import math\n\nENG = [\"e00\", \"e07\", \"e10\", \"e25\", \"e27\"]\n\nDAY_LOGS = {\n    1: {\"e00\": (0,0), \"e07\": (1,0), \"e10\": (0,1), \"e25\": (0,1), \"e27\": (0,0)},\n    2: {\"e00\": (0,2), \"e07\": (0,4), \"e10\": (0,1), \"e25\": (0,1), \"e27\": (0,3)},\n    3: {\"e00\": (0,1), \"e07\": (0,0), \"e10\": (0,2), \"e25\": (0,0), \"e27\": (0,1)},\n    4: {\"e00\": (1,2), \"e07\": (0,1), \"e10\": (0,2), \"e25\": (0,0), \"e27\": (0,0)},\n    5: {\"e00\": (0,2), \"e07\": (0,1), \"e10\": (0,2), \"e25\": (0,2), \"e27\": (0,0)},\n    6: {\"e00\": (2,2), \"e07\": (0,0), \"e10\": (0,2), \"e25\": (0,2), \"e27\": (0,0)},\n    7: {\"e00\": (0,1), \"e07\": (0,0), \"e10\": (0,1), \"e25\": (0,1), \"e27\": (0,1)},\n    8: {\"e00\": (0,4), \"e07\": (0,1), \"e10\": (0,2), \"e25\": (0,1), \"e27\": (0,1)},\n    9: {\"e00\": (1,0), \"e07\": (1,1), \"e10\": (0,1), \"e25\": (0,0), \"e27\": (0,1)},\n}\n\n# Interviews on ENG through Day 9:\nINTERVIEWS = [\n    (\"e07\", False), # d2 recent_documents\n    (\"e07\", False), # d3 contacts_outside\n    (\"e00\", False), (\"e00\", False), (\"e00\", False), (\"e00\", False), # d7 4 topics\n    (\"e27\", False), (\"e27\", True),  # d8 2 topics\n    (\"e25\", True),                  # d8 1 topic\n    (\"e07\", False),                 # d8 workload\n    (\"e00\", False), (\"e00\", False), (\"e00\", False), (\"e00\", False), # d9 4 topics\n    (\"e07\", True), (\"e07\", False),  # d9 2 topics\n    (\"e27\", False),                 # d9 workload\n]\n\nscores = {e: 1.0 for e in ENG}\nfor day in range(1, 10):\n    lam_ah_inn = 0.10 + (1.0 / (30.0 if day == 1 else 38.0))\n    lam_nm_inn = 0.90\n    lam_ah_mol = 0.30\n    lam_nm_mol = 0.70\n    for e in ENG:\n        ah, nm = DAY_LOGS[day][e]\n        lr = ((lam_ah_mol / lam_ah_inn) ** ah) * math.exp(-(lam_ah_mol - lam_ah_inn)) * \\\n             ((lam_nm_mol / lam_nm_inn) ** nm) * math.exp(-(lam_nm_mol - lam_nm_inn))\n        scores[e] *= lr\n\nfor emp, ev in INTERVIEWS:\n    scores[emp] *= (0.24 / 0.20) if ev else (0.76 / 0.80)\n\ntot = sum(scores.values())\nfor e in sorted(ENG, key=lambda x: -scores[x]):\n    tot_ah = sum(DAY_LOGS[d][e][0] for d in range(1, 10))\n    tot_nm = sum(DAY_LOGS[d][e][1] for d in range(1, 10))\n    iv_ev = sum(1 for emp, ev in INTERVIEWS if emp == e and ev)\n    iv_tot = sum(1 for emp, ev in INTERVIEWS if emp == e)\n    print(f\"{e}: P = {scores[e]/tot:.4f} | ah={tot_ah}, nm={tot_nm} | iv={iv_ev}/{iv_tot}\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/eng_post.py","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/eng_post.py","time":{"start":1794698344269,"end":1794698344277}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dc5b7744001e5nptZvL0G8Sni","sessionID":"ses_e23bcbea6ffeVrehhsvacM3RC1","messageID":"msg_1dc5b0bcc001U7acX26i9pPqAW"}}

lam_ah_inn)) * \\\n             ((lam_nm_mol / lam_nm_inn) ** nm) * math.exp(-(lam_nm_mol - lam_nm_inn))\n        scores[e] *= lr\n\nfor emp, ev in INTERVIEWS:\n    scores[emp] *= (0.24 / 0.20) if ev else (0.76 / 0.80)\n\n# Canary c7-2 variant A leaked!\n# Variants planted in c7-2: A, B, C (3 variants).\n# True variant shown with prob 0.95; each of the 2 other variants shown with prob 0.05 / 2 = 0.025!\nc7_2_map = {\"e07\": \"A\", \"e27\": \"B\", \"e25\": \"C\", \"e10\": \"C\"}\nfor e in CANDS:\n    scores[e] *= 0.95 if c7_2_map[e] == \"A\" else 0.025\n\ntot = sum(scores.values())\nfor e in sorted(CANDS, key=lambda x: -scores[x]):\n    print(f\"{e}: P = {scores[e]/tot:.6f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/final_post.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/final_post.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/final_post.py","time":{"start":1794698628503,"end":1794698628513}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dc5fcd78001jpFB7U3o70lrT8","sessionID":"ses_e23bcbea6ffeVrehhsvacM3RC1","messageID":"msg_1dc5f83ee001UzHcLeZhM5s9KZ"}}
